messages.text:
Happy to. The Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s, tunable 30 to 50 TH/s, about 650W at 40 TH/s, and it's a Batch 5 pre-sale that ships November 14.

The numbers that matter depend on your power price, so tell me your state (or country) and I'll run the sats stacked per month, your power cost at the local rate, break-even BTC price and the solo-block odds. If you know your per-kWh rate, even better, give me that too.

Here's B., run at a generic $0.17/kWh because I don't have a BC-specific rate loaded, so tell me your actual per-kWh and I'll redo it.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650W:
Stacks about 57,300 sats a month, worth roughly $47.78 today. Power at $0.17 is about $80.62 a month, so at today's BTC price you're down about $33 a month. Break-even BTC price is $140,649. Solo block pays about $261,900, odds roughly 1 in 164,985 a day, 0.22% over a year.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 405W:
About 42,990 sats a month ($35.83), power about $50.23, down about $14 a month. Break-even $116,847.

BC Hydro is well under that generic rate, so both look better for you than these lines show. Honest framing: at retail power this is stacking sats and buying a jackpot ticket, not monthly profit. The 40T stacks more sats and costs less per TH ($19.98 vs $29.97), so it's my pick. Today's estimate, BTC price and difficulty move.

context.pop: Hey, it's Sarah. Noticed you've been looking at Magic Miner 40T. Want me to run the numbers for where you live, or answer anything before you decide?
